human_executive_summary.description: High-signal summary designed to be read by the human gatekeeper. Do not include dry file diffs or query logs here.

bottom_line.description: High-signal one sentence summary of the issue.

proof_verified.description: Did independent checks establish the conclusion within its stated scope? False if material proof remains unverified; explain limitations in risks_or_gaps.

risks_or_gaps.description: Any residual risks, edge cases, or gaps in the investigation.

recommended_action.description: What should the human orchestrator do next? (e.g. 'Create hotfix task for webhook handler')

challenges_for_investigator.description: If decision is REVISE, list specific numbered challenges for the investigator to address in the next cycle.
